name: Shop
description:
Sells various pickups and items from the Shop item pool in exchange for coins.

Requires a key to open, except on floor 1, where it is always unlocked.

Appears in every chapter before the Womb (one per floor). Also appears adjacent to the Blue Womb starting room.

Starting from the second floor of Chapter 2, the Shop has a chance of being replaced by a Greed or Super Greed fight when entered, unless both mini-bosses have been defeated during the run.

The Shop typically contains a Donation Machine, a Shopkeeper, and a few rocks and/or Fire Places. It can rarely contain Keeper enemies and neutral Flies.

Merchandise
The following stuff can be sold at a Shop:

• 3¢ → Heart.

• 5¢ → Soul Heart, Bomb, Key, Lil' Battery, pills, or cards.

• 7¢ → Grab Bag.

• 15¢ → any item from the Shop item pool. Certain items are sold for 10¢.

Any pickup or item in the Shop has a chance of being 50% off. Such items are marked with a red price tag instead of the usual white.

Discounted prices are rounded down for items and Grab Bags and rounded up for pickups.

Upgrading the Shop
The Shop typically includes a Donation Machine that can be used to permanently upgrade Shops on a save file by donating coins to it.

The following Shop upgrades are possible via donating coins:

• 20¢ - Level 1

• 100¢ - Level 2

• 200¢ - Level 3

• 600¢ - Level 4

The Shop levels determine the room layouts that will be selected, with higher levels having higher-quality layouts. For a full list of room layouts, check out the Isaac Wiki.

If playing on Normal mode, the Shop layout will always be of the highest unlocked level, while Hard mode can select a layout of any unlocked level.

Greed Mode
In Greed Mode, the Shop is a wide room that is always unlocked and available on every floor, except the Ultra Greed floor.

It always contains a Heart, a Key, an item from the Greed Shop item pool, an item from the Greed Boss Room item pool, and 2 random pickups, trinkets, or items from the Greed Treasure Room item pool.

The Greed Mode Shop cannot be replaced by Greed or Super Greed.

name: Secret Shop
description:
The Secret Shop is exclusive to Member Card. The trap door leading to it appears inside a regular Shop while holding the item.

The Secret Shop sells 2-5 of the following:

• Trinket (15¢).

• Item (15-30¢) from the following item pools: Secret Room, Shop, Devil Room, Angel Room and Boss. Devil/Angel items can cost up to 50¢ while Secret Room items can go up to 99¢.

• Card/Rune/Soul Stone (6-8¢).

• Black Heart/Bone Heart (8¢).

• Eternal Heart (15¢).

• Rotten Heart (5¢).

The trap door will spawn even if Greed or Super Greed was fought in the shop.

Other items spawned in the Secret Shop will be selected from the Shop item pool, or Greed Shop if playing on Greed Mode.

Only one Secret Shop may exist per floor. If multiple entrances are found, they will both lead to the same room.

This room is not part of the playable area and exists outside of the map's boundaries.

name: Angel Shop
description:
The Angel Shop is exclusive to The Stairway. The stairway leading to it appears inside the starting room of any floor.

The Angel Shop will always contain the following:

• An item from the Angel Room item pool.

• Eternal Heart.

• Soul Heart.

• Key.

• Holy Card.

• Angel statue that can be fought for a Key Piece.

• Beggar or Rotten Beggar next to the entrance.

• Confessional, if unlocked.

Items and pickups can be on sale just like in regular Shops.

The ladder will disappear once Isaac leaves the starting room.

The ladder will also appear in Greed Mode, and it will instead use the Greed Angel Room item pool.

Only one Angel Shop may exist per floor. If multiple entrances are found, they will both lead to the same room.

This room is not part of the playable area and exists outside of the map's boundaries.

name: I AM ERROR
description:
A room that can only be accessed via rare scenarios, including glitches, and acts as a failsafe for certain events.

The room does not contain any doors, but only an exit leading to the next floor.

Contains at least one I AM ERROR Shopkeeper, and often multiple items from random item pools, pickups, beggars, and/or enemies, including bosses.

Once Delirium is defeated as Tainted Eden, items spawned in the I AM ERROR room have a 6.25% chance of spawning affected by TMTRAINER.

How to access the I AM ERROR room

• Telepills - small chance of a teleport.

• Undefined - 24.75% chance of a teleport.

• Teleport 2.0 - once all other special rooms have been explored.

• Red Key - by creating a door that leads outside of the map boundaries.

• Blank Card - when used while holding ? Card.

• Lil Portal - creating a trap door inside the Lil Portal room.

• Cursed Penny - 10% chance when picking up a Golden Penny.

• Leaving a Crawl Space through an unintended direction (glitching out).

Entering the I AM ERROR room from the Womb or later floors may result in a trap door leading to the wrong path, forcing the run to end early.

This room is not part of the playable area and exists outside of the map's boundaries.

name: Treasure Room
description:
Contains a single item (rarely 2 items) from the Treasure Room item pool, and sometimes a Shop Restock Machine.

Requires a key to open, except on floor 1, where it is always unlocked.

Appears in every chapter before the Womb (one per floor). 2 also appear adjacent to the Blue Womb starting room.

When the floor is affected by Curse of the Labyrinth!, 2 Treasure Rooms will spawn.

In Greed Mode, a locked Treasure Room spawns on every floor except for The Shop and Ultra Greed, and contains items from the Greed Treasure Room item pool instead.

When a Treasure Room contains 2 items, only one of them can be taken, while the other one disappears. Rarely, some room layouts allow for both items to be taken.

When on the alternate path, the Treasure Room always contains 2 items, of which one is affected by Curse of the Blind!. Only one item may be taken.

Rarely, 3 items may appear in the Treasure Room on the alternate path. In this case, one can be taken freely, and the other 2 will be a choice.

A few very rare room layouts exist where the Treasure Room does not have any items.

name: Silver Treasure Room
description:
The Silver Treasure room is exclusive to Greed Mode.

It appears connected to the lower-right side of the main room on every floor except for The Chest and Ultra Greed.

The room contains an item (sometimes a choice of 2 items) from the Greed Boss Room item pool. It can sometimes contain a Shop Restock Machine, some Bulbs, and various pickups.

name: Devil Treasure Room
description:
The Devil Treasure Room replaces the regular Treasure Room when holding Devil's Crown.

It acts similarly to a Treasure Room, but instead contains items from the Devil Room item pool in exchange for heart containers.

Taking an item from the Devil Treasure Room counts as making a deal with the devil.

The Treasure Room is instantly replaced and switched back when picking up or dropping Devil's Crown, unless it has been visited.

The reversed Treasure Room in Downpour/Dross II may not be converted into a Devil Treasure Room.

In Greed Mode, the Devil Treasure Room will instead use the Greed Devil Room item pool. It does not affect the Silver Treasure Room.

name: Boss Room
description:
The Boss Room is the final room of every floor, featuring a fight against one of many bosses.

Upon defeating the boss, an item from the Boss item pool is spawned, some hearts (depending on difficulty), and a trap door leading to the next level.

A Devil Room or Angel Room may appear upon defeating the boss.

Some room layouts known as "Double Trouble" feature 2 bosses and a larger boss room.

Certain bosses are always fought inside a large boss room.

If the floor is affected by Curse of the Labyrinth!, two consecutive Boss Rooms will be generated, with only the second one offering a trap door to the next level, and an Angel/Devil Room.

The Boss Room cannot be blasted through in order to escape.

The eyes of the skull on the door will flash until the boss has been defeated.

name: Mega Satan Arena
description:
Found in the starting room of the Chest and Dark Room floors.

The Mega Satan Arena is a special Boss Room that features a fight against Mega Satan.

Unlocking the door requires and consumes both Key Piece 1 and Key Piece 2. It can, alternatively, be opened by an item such as Dad's Key.

name: Mother Arena Entrance
description:
The Mother Arena Entrance is found in the Boss Room of Corpse II.

It contains a single large pit that leads to the Mother fight.

name: Mini-Boss Room
description:
Contains a battle against one of the Seven Deadly Sins mini-bosses, including their Super variants, and Ultra Pride.

The Super variants may not be encountered in Stage 1.

The Mini-Boss Room door appears as a normal door until entered. It cannot be blasted through in order to escape.

Only one Mini-Boss Room can be generated on a floor.

Not every floor contains a Mini-Boss Room, and they can only generate up to Chapter 5.

name: Secret Room
description:
A room that is not visible on the map and does not have a regular door through which it can be accessed.

The Secret Room is only accessible via bombing the center of a wall that leads to it, creating a hole in the wall.

Only one Secret Room may spawn on a floor. One does not spawn in the Blue Womb and The Home floors.

Secret Rooms are typically found next to 3 or 4 adjacent rooms, and their entrance will never have an enemy spawn, rock, gap, or other grid entity in the way.

Contains at least one Shopkeeper and various pickups, or even an item.

Starting from Chapter 3, the Secret Room has a chance of featuring a fight against Greed or Super Greed, unless both mini-bosses have been defeated during the run.

A Secret Room does not appear in Greed Mode.

Once Delirium is defeated as Tainted Eden, items spawned in the I AM ERROR room have a 1.67% chance of spawning affected by TMTRAINER.

During the Ascent, no Secret Rooms may be generated.

name: Super Secret Room
description:
A room that is not visible on the map and does not have a regular door through which it can be accessed.

The Super Secret Room is only accessible via bombing the center of a wall that leads to it, creating a hole in the wall.

Only one Super Secret Room may spawn on a floor. One does not spawn in the Blue Womb and The Home floors.

Super Secret Rooms are found next to only one adjacent room which cannot be a special room, and their entrance will never have an enemy spawn, rock, gap, or other grid entity in the way.

Contains various pickups, machines/beggars, and sometimes enemies.

The floor layout of the Super Secret Room is not connected to the floor it was accessed from.

A Super Secret Room also appears in Greed Mode, and it uses the Greed Secret Room item pool instead.

name: Arcade
description:
The Arcade contains various machines and beggars, and sometimes random coins or various pickups.

It requires 1¢ to open and can only spawn on even-numbered floors. If on the alternate path, it can only spawn on the first floor of each chapter.

The Arcade may only spawn if Isaac has 5¢ when leaving the previous floor. It cannot spawn during Curse of the Labyrinth!, unless on the alternate path.

Only one Arcade may appear on a floor.

The Arcade is mutually exclusive with the Vault - both cannot appear on the same floor.

name: Curse Room
description:
A room with spikes on the door that hurt Isaac for half a heart (or a full heart starting from the Womb) when touching or going through it.

The Curse Room typically contains Red Chests, enemy spiders/Imps, Black Hearts, Devil Beggars, and often an item from the Curse Room item pool.

The damage from the Curse Room does not affect the Devil/Angel chance.

Curse Rooms may appear up to Chapter 5. Only one may appear per floor.

In Greed Mode, a Curse Room always appears adjacent to the main room and the Shop, and it instead uses the Greed Curse Room item pool.

If Isaac has flight, he will only take damage from the spikes upon exiting the room.

name: Challenge Room
description:
The Challenge Room features 3 waves of enemies in exchange for a reward.

The room will only generate on a floor if Isaac's total health is greater than or equal to his number of heart containers. This is also the requirement to open the door.

Challenge Rooms appear only on the first floor of a chapter, or during Curse of the Labyrinth!, and may appear up to Chapter 5. Only one Challenge Room may generate per floor.

The room contains one or more random chests that, when interacted with, initiate the enemy waves.

The enemies inside the room depend on the current chapter.

Starting from Chapter 4, waves of bosses (typically from Chapters 1 or 2) will spawn instead of enemies.

Each completed wave will grant 1 charge to Isaac's active item and will trigger other room-clear effects such as familiars that spawn stuff based on the number of cleared rooms.

Completing all 3 waves will yield a regular room clear reward.

If Isaac teleports out of the room after it has been initiated, returning to the room will not continue the challenge unless another chest was left unopened, or an item pedestal has been spawned.

name: Boss Challenge Room
description:
The Boss Challenge Room features 2 waves of bosses in exchange for a reward.

The room will only generate on a floor if Isaac has full health upon entering the floor, but the room may only be entered if he has one or fewer total hearts.

Boss Challenge Rooms appear only on the second floor of a chapter, and may appear up to Chapter 5. Only one Boss Challenge Room may generate per floor.

The room contains one item from the item pool that, when interacted with, initiates the boss waves.

The bosses inside the room depend on the current chapter.

Each completed wave will grant 1 charge to Isaac's active item and will trigger other room-clear effects such as familiars that spawn stuff based on the number of cleared rooms.

Completing both waves will yield a regular room clear reward.

If Isaac teleports out of the room after it has been initiated, returning to the room will not continue the challenge unless another item pedestal is present inside the room, or a chest is opened.

name: Library
description:
The Library contains one or more book-themed items from the Library item pool.

It can also contain some cards, batteries, beggars, and rarely a Wooden Chest.

Items inside the Library will often be locked behind Key Blocks or placed behind spikes.

The Library has a 5% chance of appearing on each floor, and only one may generate per floor.

Some Library room layouts are only available upon unlocking certain Shop upgrades.

name: Sacrifice Room
description:
The Sacrifice Room is a room that contains only a set of spikes in the center, and rarely some Fire Places, rocks, skulls, or a few heart pickups.

Damage from the Sacrifice Room spikes does not affect the Devil/Angel Room chance.

The chance for a Sacrifice Room to generate is ~14%. This chance is increased to ~36% if Isaac's total health is equal to or greater than his total Red Heart containers.

The Sacrifice Room is mutually exclusive with the Dice Room - both cannot appear on the same floor.

Only one Sacrifice Room may appear per floor, and they can only appear up to Chapter 5.

The spikes will deal damage even if Isaac has flight. This also applies to flying enemies, including Uriel and Gabriel that can spawn in the room.

The sacrifice counter is stored in the set of spikes themselves. This means that, if multiple sets of spikes or Sacrifice Rooms were to be created, each will yield separate rewards based on their sacrifice counters.

Damage must be taken in order to yield a reward. This means that shields such as Holy Mantle will not work.

Sacrifice Room rewards
Taking damage from the spikes deals a full heart of damage in exchange for the following rewards, based on the number of sacrifices on the current floor:

• 1/2 sacrifices → 50% chance for a Penny, or nothing. If on the first floor and the boss has been defeated under a minute, 100% chance for a Bomb.

• 3 sacrifices → 67% chance for getting the "You feel blessed!" message, which increases the chances of getting an Angel Deal over a Devil Deal. This also allows for an Angel Deal if a Devil Deal has been taken before. If a deal has not been encountered on the run, guarantees an Angel Deal on the current floor. If the chance fails, no reward is granted.

• 4 sacrifices → 50% chance for a random Chest, or nothing.

• 5 sacrifices → 67% chance for the "You feel blessed!" message (see above), and 33% chance for 3 Pennies.

• 6 sacrifices → 67% chance for a random Chest, and 33% chance of teleporting to the Angel Room, unless a Devil Room has been entered on the floor, in which case it will teleport there instead.

• 7 sacrifices → 50% chance to spawn Redemption if a Devil Deal has been taken; otherwise, 67% chance for a Soul Heart, and 33% chance for a random item from the Angel Room item pool.

• 8 sacrifices → 7 Troll Bombs.

• 9 sacrifices → spawns Uriel.

• 10 sacrifices → 50% chance for 7 Soul Hearts, and 50% chance for 30 Pennies.

• 11 sacrifices → spawns Gabriel.

• 12 or more sacrifices → 50% chance to teleport to the Dark Room floor, unless on a Challenge or Daily Run that does not end up in the Dark Room.

Note that the Sacrifice Room may be exited when Uriel or Gabriel spawn, allowing the fight to be skipped.

name: Devil Room
description:
The Devil Room entrance appears upon defeating the floor boss inside the Boss Room.

Inside, Isaac can exchange heart containers for items from the Devil Room item pool. This is referred to as making a "deal with the devil".

Devil Deal items require 1 heart container by default, with the exception of some more powerful items that require 2.

Sometimes, the Devil Room may instead contain Black Hearts, Red Chests, Devil Beggars, Mom's (Dead) Hand enemy, or Nulls.

The Devil Room does not always appear. Its appearance is tied to Isaac's Devil Room chance, and can only appear up to Chapter 4.

When a Devil Room is about to spawn, there is a chance for it to be replaced with an Angel Room instead, depending on Isaac's Angel Room chance.

Items with the devilsacrifice item tag will appear with a sacrificial spike instead of requiring a heart container. This type of deal has a 50% chance to award the item on the first attempt, and 100% on the second. This, too, counts as taking a devil deal.

Occasionally, the Krampus mini-boss will appear inside a Devil Room (once per run); in this case, no deal items will appear in the room.

In Greed Mode, an Angel/Devil Room is guaranteed to appear upon defeating the final, optional wave of each floor. The Devil Room will instead use the Greed Devil Room item pool.

When leaving the Devil Room, the door is not guaranteed to stay. It is affected by Isaac's Devil Room chance every time.

Characters that don't have any Red Hearts, will use their corresponding heart type for the deals, such as Soul Hearts, or Coin Hearts.

The Lost and Tainted Lost (or any other character in ghost form) can take one item from the Devil Room for free, while the other items disappear.

This room is not part of the playable area and exists outside of the map's boundaries.

name: Angel Room
description:
The Angel Room entrance appears upon defeating the floor boss inside the Boss Room, unless a deal with the devil has been made before.

The room typically contains one or a choice of more items from the Angel Room item pool, and sometimes Eternal Hearts, Soul Hearts, or Eternal Chests.

The Angel Room will always contain an Angel Statue in the middle (rarely 2) that spawns the Uriel or Gabriel mini-boss when bombed, which drop Key Piece 1 and Key Piece 2, respectively.

The Angel Room does not always appear. Its appearance is tied to Isaac's Angel Room chance, and can only appear up to Chapter 4.

When an Angel Room is about to spawn, there is a chance for it to be replaced with a Devil Room instead, depending on Isaac's Devil Room chance.

In Greed Mode, an Angel/Devil Room is guaranteed to appear upon defeating the final, optional wave of each floor. The Angel Room will instead use the Greed Angel Room item pool.

When leaving the Angel Room, the door is not guaranteed to stay. It is affected by Isaac's Angel Room chance every time.

This room is not part of the playable area and exists outside of the map's boundaries.

name: Crawl Space
description:
The Crawl Space is a hidden room that is viewed from the side, rather than from above. This means the room has gravity that pulls Isaac to the floor, and he must use ladders to traverse the floors.

The room typically contains various pickups, enemies, and sometimes an item from the Treasure Room item pool.

Sometimes, the Crawl Space will include a passage that leads to a Black Market.

A Crawl Space may be entered/discovered in the following ways:

• Using We Need To Go Deeper! or Ehwaz on a special tile (e.g. grass).

• Bombing the carpet inside a Clean Bedroom.

• Destroying a rock - random chance.

• Using Chaos Card on the Great Gideon boss.

• Using XXI - The World?.

Only one rock per floor is able to hide a Crawl Space entrance.

Only one Crawl Space may exist per floor. If multiple entrances are found, they will both lead to the same room.

Leaving a Crawl Space from an unintended exit (glitching out) will lead to the I AM ERROR room.

This room is not part of the playable area and exists outside of the map's boundaries.

name: Boss Rush
description:
The Boss Rush room becomes available upon defeating Mom in Chapter 3 within 20 minutes, or within 25 minutes during the alternate path. The entrance appears in Mom's Boss Room.

Boss Rush is a large room which contains 2, 4, or 8 random items from the Treasure Room item pool.

Upon picking up one of the items, the other disappear, and waves of 15 bosses will start to appear.

Each wave consists of 2 random bosses, and the next wave will not start until the previous one has been cleared.

Each boss may only appear once.

The following bosses may not appear in Boss Rush:

• Scolex.

• Conquest.

• Lokii.

• Teratoma.

• Daddy Long Legs.

• Triachnid.

• Mama Gurdy.

• Mr. Fred.

• Any final boss.

• Any Sin or Super Sin.

• Krampus.

• Uriel or Gabriel.

• Any boss added in Afterbirth+ or Repentance.

Completing Boss Rush will award an additional item from the Treasure Room item pool.

The Boss Rush door remains open as long as 20 minutes have not passed. This is also the case upon completing Boss Rush.

If the fight has been exited prior to completion, it can be restarted only by picking up an item pedestal inside the room, opening any chest, or picking up a Grab Bag.

The 20-minute timer can be bypassed by using Mama Mega! or Mega Bean inside the Boss Room, or by holding Broken Shovel.

Boss Rush may not be entered if Mom has been defeated for the first time on a save file.

name: ??? Entrance
description:
A room containing the entrance to the ??? (Blue Womb) floor that leads to the Hush fight.

Only appears in Mom's Heart/It Lives!'s Boss Room if the boss is defeated within 30 minutes.

The door remains open as long as 30 minutes have not passed.

The 30-minute timer can be bypassed by using Mama Mega! or Mega Bean inside the Boss Room, or by holding Strange Key.
unlock: Defeat Mom's Heart for the 10th time.
unlock_text: Defeat Mom's Heart for the 10th time.

name: Clean Bedroom
description:
The Clean Bedroom requires 2 explosions in order to open.

It typically contains a bed and carpet, random pickups, and Mom's Dressing Table. Sometimes it will contain some enemies, and even Larry Jr.

The Clean Bedroom can appear only up to Chapter 3.

Bombing the carpet will create a trap door leading to a Crawl Space.

Only one Bedroom may appear per floor, and it can be either the Clean Bedroom or Dirty Bedroom.

The chance for any Bedroom to appear is 2%, and is increased to 21.6% if Isaac has only half a heart container of health (for Red Heart characters), or 1 or less Soul Hearts (for Soul Heart characters).

name: Dirty Bedroom
description:
The Dirty Bedroom requires 2 explosions in order to open.

It typically contains a bed and carpet, random pickups, and Mom's Dressing Table. Sometimes it will contain some enemies.

The Dirty Bedroom can appear only up to Chapter 3.

Bombing the carpet will create a trap door leading to the next floor.

Only one Bedroom may appear per floor, and it can be either the Dirty Bedroom or Clean Bedroom.

The chance for any Bedroom to appear is 2%, and is increased to 21.6% if Isaac has only half a heart container of health (for Red Heart characters), or 1 or less Soul Hearts (for Soul Heart characters).

name: Vault
description:
The Vault requires 2 keys to open and typically contains a variety of random pickups and/or chests.

It can only spawn on the second floor of a chapter, or the first floor if on the alternate path.

There is a 1/3 chance for a Vault to generate if Isaac has 2 or more keys when entering the floor. The chance increases to 4/10 if Isaac has 5¢ or more.

The Vault is mutually exclusive with the Arcade - both cannot appear on the same floor.

name: Dice Room
description:
The Dice Room requires 2 keys to open and can be used to randomize various elements of a run.

It rarely contains a few pickups, and always has a big symbol in the center representing one of the sides of a 6-sided die.

The side of the die currently shown will determine which elements of a run will be rerolled when stepped on:

• 1 pip - rerolls Isaac's items into random items from the item pool they were acquired from, similar to the D4.

• 2 pips - rerolls all pickups in the current room, similar to the D20.

• 3 pips - rerolls all pickups and trinkets on the floor, including ones in the Shop. Does not affect stuff in the Devil Room, Angel Room, Black Market, or Crawl Space. Pickups in the Shop may be rerolled into items.

• 4 pips - rerolls all item pedestals on the floor, similar to The D6. Does not affect stuff in the Devil Room, Angel Room, Black Market, Crawl Space, or Library. 

• 5 pips - rerolls and restarts the current floor, similar to the Forget Me Now.

• 6 pips - combines the effects of the 1-, 3-, and 4-pip rooms, similar to the D100.

Only one reroll is possible per Dice Room.

The Dice Room is mutually exclusive with the Sacrifice Room - both cannot appear on the same floor.

It has a 2% chance to replace a Sacrifice Room, or ~22% if Isaac has 2 or more keys.

name: Black Market
description:
The Black Market is a 2-room-wide hidden shop that can be accessed via a passage inside a Crawl Space.

The left side of the Black Market contains a door leading back to the entrance and a trap door leading to the next floor.

The center contains several items from the Shop item pool that are sold in exchange for heart containers, similar to a Devil Deal, although this does not count as making a deal with the devil.

The Black Market also includes a bunch of Shopkeepers, beggars, and sometimes various pickups.

The Black Market can also be accessed via Telepills, Undefined, and Cursed Penny. If entered this way, there will be no door leading back, and Isaac will be forced to go to the next floor.

Only one Black Market may exist per floor. If multiple entrances are found, they will both lead to the same room.

This room is not part of the playable area and exists outside of the map's boundaries.

name: Greed Exit Room
description:
The Greed Exit Room appears only in Greed Mode, and is always connected to the south of the main room.

The door is unlocked upon defeating all required enemy waves, and its sole purpose is having a trap door leading to the next floor.

Explosions may not be used to blast the door open.

The room may contain various pickups, chests, and enemies.

name: Planetarium
description:
The Planetarium requires a key to open. It contains a single item from the Planetarium item pool and, rarely, some cards.

Planetariums may only appear up to Chapter 3. They can also appear in Mausoleum/Gehenna II accessed via A Strange Door.

The base chance for a Planetarium to appear is 1%, and it can be modified in the following ways:

• +20% → going to the next floor.

• -20% → entering a Treasure Room.

• +24% → holding Telescope Lens.

• +15% → holding Crystal Ball, or 100% if a Treasure Room has been skipped.

• +15% → holding Magic 8 Ball.

• +6.9% → holding Sausage.

• Set to 1% → entering a Planetarium, or set to 10% if holding Telescope Lens.

The chance for a Planetarium to appear may not go below 0%.

Entering a Treasure Room inside the Mirrored World does not affect the Planetarium chance.

If the floor is affected by Curse of the Labyrinth!, it will grant a double bonus to the Planetarium chance when going down to the next floor.
unlock: Collect 3 items with the {{tag|stars}} item tag in a single run.
unlock_text: Collect 3 items with the stars item tag in a single run.

name: Alternate Path Exit Room
description:
These rooms appear attached to the Boss Room once the boss has been defeated, and offer a way of traversing to the alternate path.

The door's appearance is different based on the floor it leads to, and has different requirements:

• Downpour/Dross → requires a key.

• Mines/Ashpit → requires 2 explosions.

• Mausoleum/Gehenna → requires 2 hearts.

• Corpse → requires Knife Piece 1 and Knife Piece 2.

name: A Strange Door
description:
A Strange Door appears in the starting room of the second floor of Chapter 3.

It contains a trap door leading to a special version of Mausoleum/Gehenna II, ultimately leading to the Ascent path and The Beast fight.

The door requires and will consume either The Polaroid or The Negative.

Given the fact that Mom's Boss Room does not have an exit, Isaac must teleport out upon acquiring one of the items. To accommodate this, a Marked Skull is guaranteed to appear somewhere on the floor, which drops 0 - The Fool when destroyed.

Alternatively, the door can be opened with the Faded Polaroid, Broken Padlock, Cracked Orb, Soul of Cain, or Sharp Key.

name: Blue Womb Room
description:
Blue Womb rooms are exclusive to the Blue Key trinket.

They are created when holding the trinket and attempting to enter a door that requires a key or coins to open. They act as an in-between of said room and the room Isaac is currently in.

Blue Womb rooms contain a variety of Blue Gapers, Blue Boils, and Blue Conjoined Fatties.

They usually appear as long rooms, and can yield a regular room-clear reward.

Once a Blue Womb Room is exited, it cannot be re-entered.

The door leading to Hush will also create a Blue Womb room.

This room is not part of the playable area and exists outside of the map's boundaries.

name: Ultra Secret Room
description:
The Ultra Secret Room is a hidden room not connected to any other room on the map.

Instead, the Ultra Secret Room may only be accessed directly via an attached Red Room, using Red Key.

When a Red Room adjacent to the Ultra Secret Room is entered, the hole in the wall leading to it is automatically revealed and may be entered even without clearing the room.

Alternatively, the Ultra Secret Room may be accessed via XVIII - The Moon?.

The room contains 1 or 2 items from the Ultra Secret Room item pool. It can rarely contain Greed Gapers, and very rarely a bunch of keys instead of an item.

Only one Ultra Secret Room exists per floor.

name: Deathmatch Room
description:
The Deathmatch Room is exclusive to and only appears in Online Co-op.

It is a unique arena-themed room in which all players are placed after a successful co-op run.

Upon their placement in the Deathmath Room, the players' character is set to Isaac and they are given 90 seconds to fight each other.

The regular health bar is replaced with a new heart system which gradually drains, and invincibility frames are gradually reduced upon getting hit. Only one player may be the winner.

After the 90-second timer has elapsed, Fly Bombs and retractable spikes will randomly start appearing around the arena.

The health bar is refilled by one segment by picking up items and pickups that heal Red Hearts, while Soul Hearts and Black Hearts will increase the health bar by one segment.

Deathmatch Modes
Various Deathmatch Modes exist within the Deathmatch Room, chosen at random. They revolve around the following items and effects:

• Random - random items and pickups previously collected during the run are spawned around the room.

• Ipecac - Ipecac.

• Knockout - Knockout Drops.

• Knife Fight - Mom's Knife.

• Indigestion - Wait What?, Butt Bombs, Jupiter, 9 Volt.

• Machinegun - Soy Milk, Spoon Bender, Taurus, Thunder Thighs, Bucket of Lard.

• Ludo - The Ludovico Technique, Proptosis, Cat-o-nine-tails, Whip Worm.

• Sumo - Belly Jelly, players are unable to fire tears.

• Sword Fight - Spirit Sword, Trinity Shield, low tear rate.

• Venom - Mysterious Liquid, Aquarius, Lost Cork, tears have a lobbed effect.

• Bomber Boy - Bomber Boy, Golden Bomb, 99 bombs.

This room is not part of the playable area and exists outside of the map's boundaries.

name: Red Room
description:
Red Rooms are rooms that are created exclusively via Red Key, Cracked Key, Crystal Key, or Soul of Cain.

A Red Room may be created anywhere in the 13x13 map area, where there are no conditions that prevent a room from spawning. Such spots are marked by red outlines on the walls.

Red Rooms can take the shape of many other types of rooms, be it a normal or special room, with the Ultra Secret Room being the only unique Red Room.

Special rooms have a 10% chance of being created as opposed to normal rooms.

Multiple special rooms of the same type may be created on a floor.

Red Rooms can take the shape of the following special rooms:

• Angel Room

• Arcade

• Clean Bedroom

• Curse Room

• Devil Room

• Dice Room

• Dirty Bedroom

• Library

• Mini-Boss Room

• Planetarium

• Sacrifice Room

• Secret Room

• Shop

• Super Secret Room

• Treasure Room

• Vault

These special rooms may use layouts that cannot normally be encountered, e.g. an Arcade affected by Cain's Birthright, or even the Downpour/Dross Treasure Room that contains Knife Piece 1.

All doors adjacent to a Red Room will be automatically unlocked and opened upon entering. This also includes any type of Secret Rooms.

There is a unique Red Room found on the Home floor, in the room right under Mom's room. This is the room in which Tainted characters are unlocked, or Inner Child can be found if the character has already been unlocked, or a Shopkeeper if Inner Child has not been unlocked yet.

If a Red Room door would lead outside of the 13x13 map area, it will take Isaac to the I AM ERROR room instead. Such a room will not show a red outline on the wall.

Special Red Rooms created in the Mirrored World will appear empty.

Red Rooms are not available in Greed Mode, despite red outlines appearing on walls.

name: Mirror Room
description:
The Mirror Room is a unique room that appears only in Downpour/Dross II.

The room contains a Mirror on one of the walls that can be used to traverse to the Mirrored World.

The Mirrored World is a left-to-right-mirrored replica of the current floor, but with empty special rooms, except for the Boss Room, which features another fight with the same boss.

The Treasure Room inside the Mirrored World contains Knife Piece 1.

The Mirror may only be entered after Isaac enters ghost form by touching the White Fire Place found on the floor.

Alternatively, the Mirror can be entered by The Lost, Tainted Lost, Tainted Forgotten, and Tainted Jacob's ghost form.

The Mirror can be broken with an explosion or certain tear effects, making traversal between the 2 worlds impossible, and granting -7 luck.

If the Mirror is broken while Isaac is inside the Mirrored World, he will die. Having extra lives will keep Isaac in the Mirrored world, essentially ending the run.

name: Mine Cart Room
description:
The Mine Cart Room is a unique room that appears only in Mines/Ashpit II if Isaac holds Knife Piece 1 when entering the floor.

The room contains a Rail Plate (golden button), rails, and a minecart, and occasionally some enemies. The top of the room contains a blocked door that leads to the Mineshaft.

The Mineshaft is a special area that features a chase sequence with Mother's Shadow, and is how Isaac can obtain Knife Piece 2.

In order to unblock the Mineshaft door, Isaac must press the Rail Plate in the room, and 2 additional Rail Plates that generate randomly on the floor.

Alternatively, the door can be opened with 2 explosions.

The door becomes permanently sealed upon leaving the Mineshaft.

name: Grave Room
description:
The Grave Room is a single room that appears in the Dark Room.

It contains one or more Dirt Patches that can be dug into by using We Need To Go Deeper!, Mom's Shovel, or Ehwaz.

The Dirt Patches uncover a random chest when dug up.

The Forgotten is unlocked by using Mom's Shovel on a Dirt Patch.

Occasionally, the room may contain a few enemies, and We Need To Go Deeper!.

name: Lil Portal Room
description:
A unique room available exclusively via the portal created by Lil Portal.

The contents of the room remain unchanged for the duration of the run, and it may be accessed from any floor by creating the portal again.

Any trapdoors created in the portal room will lead to the I AM ERROR room.

Internally, the Lil Portal Room is a copy of the starting room of the floor, and not an actual new type of room.

This room is not part of the playable area and exists outside of the map's boundaries.
